name: Thames Water: Water resources in your area (reservoir levels and rainfall)
gives: end-of-month London reservoir percent full, with West London and Lee Valley split, as page text and infographic images

interface: HTML text plus two PNG images; no download, no API seen.
notes: Read 18 Nov 2026. Says (end of October 2026): 'Reservoirs in London were 56% full (52% full in West London and 74% full in Lee Valley)', below average. All rights reserved and no data licence, so use only as a cross-check or a cited quote; build on the OGL sources above.
